Raw gpg import probes: all rc=0 except Apache rc=2. Failure types: (1) PGP-2/v3 keys skipped silently, exit 0, no IMPORT_PROBLEM (FreeBSD 21, Apache 33); port would drop the person with no skip line. (2) An orphan revocation certificate (no matching key in the batch) makes gpg exit 2; port treats it as fatal: union port aborted after 240s, rc=1, no drafts. (3) That abort's message shows only gpg's first stderr line (the faked-time warning), not the cause or the file. Not an issue: SHA-1 certifications survive import (test_sha1_certification_is_drafted). Also found and fixed: drafts ignored certifications on bare-address UIDs (259f419). Harmless: duplicate sigs merged, bad/unchecked third-party sigs."}
